rows.Answer: Yes, under government control at $80.00 per year

rows.Question: What members of your family, if any, have no allotment?
rows.Answer: Francis Menard, son, age 2. Have no allotment, government runs out. My wife and all my children need my support

rows.Question: What practical business experience have you had?

rows.Answer: Yes, 160 acres, value $4,000. House and barn, 40 acres under cultivation, all fenced

rows.Question: Set forth fully your reasons for requesting a patent in fee.
rows.Answer: My intention is to sell this 160 acres and to improve on my other 160 acres, and to buy more stocks and farm implements
